verify.template:
Run the full Python verification suite at repo root:
1. ruff check .
2. ruff format --check .
3. ty check
4. uv tool run pytest -q --python .venv

Show any failures and suggest fixes.
verify.description: Python 四项验收（ruff → ty → pytest）

test.template:
Run pytest for the relevant test directory. Use -q for quiet, -x to stop on first failure.
If no directory specified, run `uv tool run pytest -q --python .venv` at repo root.
